title: Compatible vector presentations of the restricted diagonal DNC
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], Y a Noetherian scheme, d a natural number and p the ordered affine projection [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], smooth of relative dimension d. Let aY:Y→Spec k be locally finite type and quasi-compact, V an affine open of Y and H the affine diagonal geometry [lem-pur-affine-target-diagonal-dnc]. Put B=p inverse V, h=p restricted to V, g=pr1 on B×_V B, s=diagonal h, q the actual normal-cone projection and z its zero section [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. There exist a rank-d finite locally free module F on B [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], an isomorphism n:E(F)≅N_s preserving projection and zero, and an isomorphism e:E(F)≅B×_V B preserving projection and carrying zero to s. Write cN:C(q,z)≅C(pi_F,0_F) and cS:C(g,s)≅C(pi_F,0_F) for the canonical section exchanges over identity, each precomposed by the inverse identity-pullback comparison. Let sc,nc be the actual site comparisons and nu-star the comparison functor. Then delta.hom followed by nc.hom and nu-star(cN.hom) equals sc.hom followed by nu-star(cS.hom), where delta is the unique normalized DNC comparison [thm-pur-dnc-invariance, def-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement-data]. No trace or beta occurs.

proof.text: Apply affineTowerSection_vectorCoordinates to the published restrictedAffineDiagonalCoordinates. This constructs the free-bundle frame and an initial presentation of the source diagonal pair.

Construct the actual geometric Rees model by transporting the published standard-pair isomorphism. Its two fibre pullbacks provide the final source and normal presentations. vectorSection_reesReadings constructs a single family trivialization and proves the two required readings. No DNC comparison equation is assumed.

Transport the family target from the vector section invariant to the source invariant. Naturality of the endpoint counits gives normalization at one and the specified reading at zero. Apply delta_etale_reading and cancel inverse isomorphisms. Uniqueness of the normalized comparison identifies SectionRestriction.delta with OrientationRefinement.delta.

theorem restrictedAffineDiagonalDncVectorCoordinates (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (affineTraceProjection Y d)]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V) :
    letI := H.separated
    letI := H.finiteType
    letI := H.quasiCompact
    letI := H.smoothDimension
    letI := H.baseFiniteType
    letI := H.baseQuasiCompact
    letI := H.sourceSeparated
    letI := H.sourceFiniteType
    letI := H.sourceQuasiCompact
    let h := affineTraceProjection Y d ∣_ V.1
    let B := (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme
    let aB := h ≫ V.1.ι ≫ aY
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    letI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d h
    let g := pullback.fst h h
    let s := pullback.diagonal h
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P g aB
    letI := Dnc.invertibleExponent P (g ≫ aB)
    let q := Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s
    letI := Dnc.normalCompactifiable P d g aB s (pullback.diagonal_fst h)
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d q :=
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeData d (pullback.diagonal_fst h)).smoothOfRelativeDimension_proj
    letI := Dnc.invertibleExponent P (q ≫ aB)
    let ν := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ (F : B.Modules) (hF : F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d),
      letI := hF
      letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).1
      letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).2.1
      letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) aB
      ∃ (n : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ s.ker.normalCone)
        (w : n.hom ≫ q = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
        (hz : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ n.hom = s.normalConeZeroSection)
        (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ pullback h h)
        (we : e.hom ≫ g = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
        (ze : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ e.hom = s),
        (OrientationRefinement.delta P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V H).hom ≫
            (Dnc.normalComparison P d g aB s (pullback.diagonal_fst h)).hom ≫
            ν.map (vectorModelSectionComparison P.Coefficient d q s.normalConeZeroSection
              F n w hz).hom =
          (Dnc.sourceComparison P d g aB s).hom ≫
            ν.map (vectorModelSectionComparison P.Coefficient d g s F e we ze).hom
